candidate_workaround: Select the maximum candidate with an explicit key over the numeric similarity field.
failure_signature: Tuple maximum selection falls through to incomparable payload dictionaries when numeric similarity scores tie.
recurrence_guard: Every max or sort over scored records must declare a numeric key and never depend on payload comparability.
rollback: Retain the failed read-only probe with zero novelty credit and change no inherited proposal record.
scope_boundary: Bounded lexical novelty inspection only; no scientific-novelty or independent-reproduction claim.
title: Use score-only keys for lexical-neighbour selection
trigger_preconditions: A collection of scored records may contain equal numeric scores and non-orderable payload objects.
